subject: Rebaseline: AcmeCorp POC scope - add 'multi-intent routing' use case
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Laura Simmons <laura.simmons@acmecorp.com>; Tom Reid <tom.reid@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>

Subject: Post-call recap + proposed POC plan (AcmeCorp)

Hi Laura / Tom 

Thanks again for today's call. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we kick off the trial:

Summary of what we agreed:
- Two initial use cases: 1) customer support summarization (FAQ routing + canned replies) and 2) knowledge retrieval for internal KB.
- Success criteria: precision >= 85% on routing, average summary helpfulness >= 4/5 (survey), latency P95 < 500ms for interactive queries.
- Timeline: 4-week POC (pilot week 0: infra + data ingest; weeks 1–3: evaluation).
- Ownership: Acme validation lead (Laura) will provide sample logs and evaluation set; Redwood will deliver a test environment and weekly checkpoints.

Next steps (what I need from you):
1) Confirm the evaluation dataset delivery by EOD next Wednesday (2026-11-25).
2) Confirm the two success metrics above or suggest updates.
3) If you want any additional use case included, flag it now so we can scope impact.

I'll follow up with a short SOW and scope doc by COB today.

Thanks  looking forward to moving fast here.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

+1 (415) 555-0198

Hi Marissa 

Thanks for the recap, this looks great and covers our needs. One addition we discussed internally: we'd like to add a third use case to the POC  "multi-intent routing" (tickets that contain multiple intents should be split/routed to the appropriate queues). That's a priority for our support ops team and would be meaningful to evaluate.

Question: how much impact will adding that use case have on the overall timeline and the success criteria? We can provide annotated examples for the dataset.

Also, I attached a quick doc with sample ticket examples that show the multi-intent cases.

Laura  thanks for the quick reply and the examples, super helpful.

We can definitely add multi-intent routing to the POC. To keep expectations clear I propose the following re-baseline:

Proposed rebaseline (additions in bold):
- Use cases: 1) customer support summarization, 2) knowledge retrieval, **3) multi-intent routing (new)**.
- Success criteria (per use case):
  - Summarization: avg helpfulness >= 4/5; latency P95 < 500ms.
  - Knowledge retrieval: top-3 recall >= 80% on benchmark queries.
  - Multi-intent routing: routing precision >= 80% and intent-splitting accuracy >= 75%.
- Timeline: extend trial by 1 week (total 5 weeks). New milestones:
  - Week 0: infra + ingest
  - Week 1–2: baseline models + initial tuning
  - Week 3: multi-intent prototype + evaluation
  - Week 4: iteration based on results
  - Week 5: final evaluation & transfer to staging (if go)
- Ownership: Redwood lead (Rishi) + Eng support (David) for multi-intent; Acme validation (Laura) to provide annotated examples by 11/25.

Attachments I'm sharing now: SOW_draft.docx (outline of updated timeline & deliverables), POC_scope_v2.pdf (updated scope with multi-intent section).

If that works, we'll update the SOW and circulate for signature and plan the kick-off call next Monday (11/23) morning.

Marissa

marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachment: SOW_draft.docx; POC_scope_v2.pdf

Subject: Re: Rebaseline: AcmeCorp POC scope - add 'multi-intent routing' use case

Thanks Marissa  quick technical notes from engineering/solutions side.

Feasibility and impact:
- Multi-intent routing is feasible within the proposed +1 week extension. We'll build a lightweight splitter model that runs as a preprocessor before routing.
- Data needs: at least 500 annotated multi-intent examples for initial tuning; 1–2k examples for robust evaluation. If Acme can provide ~500 by 11/25 we can deliver a prototype in Week 3.

Updated evaluation plan & success criteria (detailed):
- Dataset: Acme provides annotated set + 1k historic tickets for holdout evaluation.
- Metrics:
  - Routing precision (per-intent) >= 80%
  - Intent-splitting F1 >= 0.75
  - System-level: end-to-end routing latency P95 < 700ms (splitter + model).
- Checkpoints:
  - Checkpoint A (end of Week 2): baseline models & initial routing evaluation
  - Checkpoint B (end of Week 3): multi-intent prototype results (deliver metrics + sample outputs)
  - Checkpoint C (end of Week 5): final evaluation & handoff plan.

Resource ask:
- Rishi: lead for model tuning and evaluation (ownership).
- David: infra + integration support for routing adapter.
- Estimated SRE hours: 12–16 dedicated across the 5-week POC.

I'll update the shared SOW and upload a versioned scope doc to the Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cAcmePOC

Camila Reyes
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
